_role: Riley Benchmark v2.0 — the FROZEN real-song guitar-separation evaluation. This is the deciding gate for every future corpus/model: run the validated fine-tune recipe, separate these mixtures, score SI-SDR + real-song BLIND vs the incumbent. Frozen 2026-08-05.
supersedes: Benchmark v1 = synthetic Virtual-Studio held-out eval (eval_real/eval_flat) — retained but NOT trustworthy alone (Campaign 2 synthetic blind was a wash despite 12/12 SI-SDR). v2.0 uses REAL songs.

dataset.citation: Pereira et al., MoisesDB: A dataset for source separation beyond 4-stems, arXiv:2307.15913
dataset.composition: 15 real full-band songs, guitar-present. Per track: mixture = sum(all stems), guitar_GT = sum(guitar-folder stems), shared-normalized. Most guitar-active 10s window. Real multitrack sum (NOT synthesis) -> no eval-on-own-synthesis bias.
dataset.guitar_definition: the MoisesDB 'guitar' instrument folder only (excludes bass, other, other_plucked)

protocol.metric: SI-SDR (median over tracks) vs guitar_GT; report per-track wins too
protocol.inference: htdemucs raw input (model normalizes internally — do NOT external-normalize); guitar = output index 0 of ['guitar','other']
protocol.deciding_gate: REAL-SONG BLIND A/B vs incumbent — the metric is necessary but not sufficient; blind on real audio decides (Riley law).
protocol.promotion_rule: >=11/15 blind -> promote · 9-10 -> wash · <=8 -> hold (binomial p~0.06 at 11/15)

reference_result_campaign_2.note: absolute negative for both = real full-band domain gap (models trained only on GuitarSet+Freesound synthesis). Relative + blind decisive.

the_bar: riley_corpus_v1.0 (hash df4167dc) is the incumbent DEFAULT corpus. A challenger corpus/model is promoted only if it beats v1.0's separator on this benchmark: SI-SDR improvement AND a real-song blind majority preferring the challenger.

production_reference.note: THE bar for DEPLOYMENT. Stock (+3.12) beats both Campaign-2 fine-tunes (Riley -2.35, naive -5.97) by ~5.5 dB on real songs — fine-tuning stock on the synthesis-only corpus REGRESSED real-song quality. A Riley separator is deployable only when it EXCEEDS +3.12 here. The Campaign-2 A/B proves corpus quality (Riley>naive), NOT separator superiority over production. Next: add real training data to close the synthesis->real gap.
